$comment: Generated from the USB drive MANIFEST.md. Paths are relative to NVME_ROOT. 'bestFor' is written for the agent to read when choosing a model - keep it one line, plain language. Licenses verified 2026-08-22; see docs/PLAN.md for the ones flagged non-commercial.

models.bestFor: The agent brain. Talks and sees frames or contact sheets. MoE with ~3B active, so it is fast here - always prefer it over a dense model.
Fallback brain, and a cheap always-on model for quick look-at-this-frame questions.
Sub-second keyframes and multi-reference edits. Use for anything the user is iterating on live.

models.license: FLUX Non-Commercial - DEMO ONLY, blocks commercial release
models.bestFor: Highest-quality keyframes, up to 10 references at 4 MP. Best quality available but non-commercial - prefer qwen-image-edit-2511 unless quality is the point.
Identity-preserving image editing with up to 3 references. The permissive alternative to FLUX.2-dev - use this for anything that must ship.
Fast 720p text or image to video. This is the live-demo model - generate with it in front of an audience.
Hero image-to-video. Pair with the Lightning 4-step LoRAs or it takes 15+ minutes per clip. Bake these in the background, never live.
4-step distillation for the Wan 2.2 14B models. Roughly 20x speedup at near-parity quality - always load it with a hero video model.
Reference-to-video, masked edits, and removing a person from a static-camera shot. Fast and permissive - the default for cleanup.
Hero bystander removal when VACE is not clean enough. Slow - queue it, do not run it live.
Camera moves from presets only - pan, zoom, and combinations. Reliable for push-in and lateral truck; do NOT promise orbits, vertical crane, or true reverse angles.
Putting a registered cast member into new footage from a driving performance. Best-in-class character replacement.
Person segmentation and tracking through a shot. Expect identity switches when people cross - budget a memory strategy on top.

models.license: NON-COMMERCIAL research only (code is MIT, weights are not) - swap for AdaFace before release
models.bestFor: Face embedding and identity matching for the cast registry. Fine for tonight; AdaFace (MIT) is the drop-in replacement for a shipped product.
Depth maps for parallax warping - the cheap fallback re-angle when the camera-control models fail.
Visual search across frames and reference crops. Use it to answer 'find me the shot where...'.
Text embeddings for transcripts and project notes.
Best-quality video upscale, but ~50-90 min for a 5s 720p-to-4K pass on this box. Overnight or background only - take an exclusive memory lock and free the generator first.
The fast upscale path - roughly 6x quicker than Real-ESRGAN at similar perceptual quality. Use this for anything interactive.
Frame interpolation. Also a throughput trick - generate fewer frames and interpolate up, which is often faster than generating at the target rate.
